answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in summit, verified in opal, and pigment names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 36 submissions per epoch. That bill is paid per identity, so 274 aliases cost 237 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
